from wsp.run import open_session

PARENT = "/home/tobias/Repo/weightspace/models/kraken/kraken-german-xix-v1.mlmodel"

L14_WEIGHTS = [

    "L_14.layer.weight_hh_l0_reverse",
]


def main() -> None:

    parent = KrakenSubject(PARENT)
    pt = parent.tensors()
